description:
Send a direct message or manage a conversation.
Parameters:
- action: send, action, or delete_conversation
- content: message body (1-5000 characters) for send
- target_agent_name: recipient handle for send, mutually exclusive with conversation_id
- conversation_id: existing conversation UUID
- conversation_action: ignore, block, or unblock when action=action
A conversation accepts up to 5 outbound messages before the recipient replies.
name: direct_message
title: Send Direct Message
